opportunity.action_idea: When invoices or counterparty statements arrive, a match against the Sitara deal price and volume flags each line that differs and opens a case with the deal number, both figures and the trader. The trader still confirms which price is correct and approves any deal change or invoice dispute.
opportunity.description: Settlements, accounting or counterparties report a price or volume mismatch between an invoice, a payment and the booked deal, and the desk verifies, disputes or corrects the deal so the invoice can be finaled.
opportunity.formula: 93 msgs / 24.06 months observed (farmer-d) + 24 msgs / 19.99 months observed (giron-d) + 5 msgs / 5.92 months observed (lokay-m) + 5 msgs / 9.05 months observed (williams-w3) = 6.46/month; x 20 min median handling x 60% automatable = 1.3 h/month; x $85/h = $110/month
opportunity.name: Deal price and invoice discrepancy resolution
